answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the falcon log shows the live set and the anchor audit records each lapse. Keeping 179 aliases alive thus means 179 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the fable quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 895 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. That is 8 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
